role: GitHub issue form "Bug report" (label bug): required what-happened, steps, versions; optional session date, strap, log excerpt (Settings → Diagnostics export). Warns not to report security issues here and not to paste raw health data.
toplevel: Form definition only. The log-export path it names exists (DiagnosticLogExport ShareLink in Emuqu/Sources/Views/SettingsPages+DiagnosticActions.swift:51).

flags.text: The log-excerpt field points users to 'Settings → Diagnostics → export', but no Settings page is called Diagnostics. The log export is on the page titled Troubleshooting, so the path in the form cannot be followed literally.
